answer: Because the raven domain is checked at the yarrow verifier, the falcon audit exposes the rejected digest, and a replayed signature costs the operator its bond. Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 8 epochs later. That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
